split: held-out S01E03/E04 head prediction-scope audit; no independent human confirmation
selection: Complete head-only prediction subset from each already frozen native report. All six before identities are an exact oriented subset of the eight after identities; review all eight, reusing only identical source/track/range/scope judgments. No selection by motion magnitude or visual grade.

candidateFrozenBeforeReview.primaryOrdering: Descending minimum of the two sides maximum SO(3) excursion within contiguous valid requested-sample runs; fixed from the training audit. No fitted weights or amplitude threshold.
candidateFrozenBeforeReview.abstention: Keep unmeasurable head candidates in their existing head-list slots; reorder only measurable slots. Ties preserve baseline head order.
candidateFrozenBeforeReview.secondarySignals: Endpoint and within-run path lengths are descriptive diagnostics only; do not choose a different signal after viewing held-out results.

metrics: Partial grade preferences within the complete head subset, with unknown judgments abstaining.
Strict and lenient P@3/P@5 unresolved-label bounds for baseline/candidate within the eight-head after list.
Complete head-subset grade counts for six-before/eight-after; not full-episode Precision, Recall, or retrieval Recall@K.
review: Up to six source-PTS frames per side plus three selected-track native pose overlays. Use a denser review for ambiguous trajectories. Scores, classes and rotation magnitudes remain off the sheets; assistant judgments retain uncertainty and are not independent human ground truth.

rubric.1: Weak, generic or redundant head resemblance without a clear distinctive parallel.
rubric.2: Clear comparable distinctive selected-head action supported by temporal and track evidence.

limits: This freezes an output-scope audit, not a matcher-independent positive-control dataset. No production ranker or classifier policy is approved by the training result alone. Do not tune on these judgments.
